```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)

out <- function(f) file.path("..", "outputs", f)
fig <- function(f) file.path("..", "outputs", "figures", f)
rd  <- function(f) read_csv(out(f), show_col_types = FALSE)

term_labels <- c(
  unemployment_rate = "Unemployment (same quarter)",
  unemployment_l1   = "Unemployment (1-quarter lag)",
  rate_l2           = "Policy rate (2-quarter lag)",
  rate_l4           = "Policy rate (4-quarter lag)",
  covid             = "COVID indicator",
  log_delinq_l1     = "Last quarter's delinquency (log)"
)
model_labels <- c(
  naive = "Last-quarter benchmark",
  ar = "Persistence only (baseline)",
  ar_macro = "Persistence + unemployment",
  ar_macro_rate = "Persistence + unemployment + policy rate",
  macro = "Economy only",
  rf_level = "Random forest (level)",
  rf_change = "Random forest (change)"
)
```

# Methods

## Why a panel with fixed effects

*[Province effects absorb permanent differences. Quarter-of-year effects absorb seasonality. No time effects because they would absorb the national policy rate.]*

# Results

## Association with unemployment and the policy rate

```{r}
#| label: fe-table
fe_file <- c("fixed_effects_models.csv", "baseline_models.csv")
fe_file <- fe_file[file.exists(out(fe_file))][1]
rd(fe_file) |>
  mutate(term = recode(term, !!!term_labels),
         cell = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", estimate, std.error)) |>
  select(term, model, cell) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = cell) |>
  kable(caption = "Provincial fixed-effects models. Coefficient (standard error).")
```

![](`r fig("unemployment_coefficients.png")`)

![](`r fig("rate_lag_profile.png")`)

## Robustness with 33 metropolitan areas

```{r}
#| label: cma-table
rd("cma_models.csv") |>
  mutate(term = recode(term, !!!term_labels),
         cell = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", estimate, std.error)) |>
  select(term, model, cell) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = cell) |>
  kable(caption = "Metropolitan-area models. Coefficient (standard error).")
```

## Heterogeneity by province

![](`r fig("heterogeneity.png")`)

## Prediction

```{r}
#| label: validation-table
rd("validation_scores_all.csv") |>
  mutate(model = recode(model, !!!model_labels)) |>
  select(Model = model, MSE = mse, RMSE = rmse, MAE = mae) |>
  kable(digits = 4, caption = "Out-of-sample error, 16 test quarters. Log points.")
```

![](`r fig("validation_rmse.png")`)

![](`r fig("validation_actual_vs_predicted.png")`)

## Scenarios

```{r}
#| label: scenario-table
rd("scenario_paths.csv") |>
  filter(date == max(date)) |>
  group_by(Scenario = scenario) |>
  summarise(`Average delinquency (%)` = mean(delinquency_rate), .groups = "drop") |>
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Average delinquency at the end of the 8-quarter horizon.")
```

![](`r fig("scenarios_average.png")`)

![](`r fig("scenarios_by_province.png")`)
